step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Shopline's e-commerce platform integrated with a third-party POS system. On the left side, there is a bidirectional data synchronization path between a Couchbase database, a Kafka streaming service, an ECS Proxy Worker, and an internal MongoDB database. On the right side, POS Client and POS Admin connect to an ECS SSO Gateway and an API Gateway (Open API). On top right, CloudWatch (CW) and S3 are drawn as standalone nodes representing the Data Lake roadmap.
